'''Unit 718-A''' was the designation given to an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] commandeered by professional [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] [[Sienn Sconn]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kalieva K'ntarr]] of [[Rydonni Prime]]. This unit was owned by forces under [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Caerbellak]], but after Sconn stole a [[Rythani Products prototype|prototype]] weapon from [[Rythani Products]], he hijacked the vehicle with Kalieva as a means of escape. Sconn accidentally [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] this unit during a royal parade in [[Rydonni Prime]]'s [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Ryell]]. Sconn engaged and defeated Caerbellak's [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]] [[Variise]] on the AT-AT's troop deck, and piloted the vehicle into the [[Rydonnian Imperial Consulate]] to serve as a distraction, destroying the [[Walker/Legends|walker]].<ref name="Easy">{{JournalCite|9|Easy Credits}}</ref>
